description: This file defines API routes for order tracking within a food delivery backend system using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for listing tracking events, appending new events, and WebSocket streaming of real-time order tracking updates. It also contains several internal helper functions for authorization and session management.

methods.name: bool _has_role(user: User, role_name: str)
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific role.

methods.name: bool _is_admin(user: User)
methods.description: Determines if a user has admin privileges.

methods.name: Order _get_order_or_404(session: AsyncSession, order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Fetches an Order by ID or raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: None _assert_can_subscribe(session: AsyncSession, order: Order, user: User)
methods.description: Verifies if the current user is permitted to subscribe to an order's tracking stream based on roles and ownership.

methods.name: None _assert_can_publish(session: AsyncSession, order: Order, user: User)
methods.description: Verifies if the current user is permitted to publish tracking events for an order.

methods.name: User _ws_get_current_user(session: AsyncSession, token: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user via JWT token for WebSocket connections.

methods.name: User _load_user_roles(session: AsyncSession, user: User)
methods.description: Loads roles associated with a user and attaches them to the user object.

methods.name: list[TrackingEventOut] list_tracking_events( order_id: UUID, limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=500, description="Max number of events to return."), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a list of tracking events for a specific order.

methods.name: TrackingEventOut append_tracking_event( order_id: UUID, payload: TrackingEventCreateRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new tracking event and publish it to subscribers.

methods.name: None ws_order_tracking(websocket: WebSocket, order_id: UUID)
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint for real-time order tracking updates, with authentication and authorization.

ctags.name: _assert_can_publish
ctags.pattern: /^async def _assert_can_publish(session: AsyncSession, order: Order, user: User) -> None:$/

ctags.name: _assert_can_subscribe
ctags.pattern: /^async def _assert_can_subscribe(session: AsyncSession, order: Order, user: User) -> None:$/

ctags.name: append_tracking_event
ctags.signature: ( order_id: UUID, payload: TrackingEventCreateRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )

ctags.name: list_tracking_events
ctags.signature: ( order_id: UUID, limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=500, description="Max number of events to return."), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )

ctags.name: ws_order_tracking
ctags.pattern: /^async def ws_order_tracking(websocket: WebSocket, order_id: UUID) -> None:$/
